originalEntry.title: Anime trailer: Claude vs ChatGPT battle
originalEntry.author: ishuagra02
originalEntry.description: A 100-second anime-style trailer of Claude and ChatGPT fighting; Opus downloaded fonts, made the audio and drew every frame in JavaScript.
originalEntry.description_zh: 100 秒动漫风预告片，Claude 对决 ChatGPT，每一帧都由 Opus 用 JavaScript 画出。
originalEntry.prompt: I want to create a highly-detailed video trailer featuring Claude and ChatGPT having a ruthless battle to be the best AI model in the world. Create an engaging story and make it action-paced with proper use of visual and sound effects. Art style must be anime-like.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 我想制作一支非常精细的视频预告片，讲 Claude 和 ChatGPT 为了成为世界上最好的 AI 模型展开一场残酷的对决。编一个引人入胜的故事，节奏紧凑、动作感强，恰当运用视觉和音效。画风必须是动漫风。
originalEntry.note: Author: one shot, $28 in API usage, about 1.5 hours.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称一次生成，API 花费 28 美元，用时约 1.5 小时。
